# routeros_ip_proxy (Resource)
Settings of the web proxy (`/ip proxy`). Access rules (`/ip proxy access`) and the cache rules are not covered. Deleting the resource only removes it from the state.

## Example Usage
```terraform
resource "routeros_ip_proxy" "this" {
  enabled = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `always_from_cache` (Boolean) Ignore client refresh requests if the content is considered fresh.
- `anonymous` (Boolean) Do not pass the client IP address to the remote server.
- `cache_administrator` (String) Administrator e-mail shown on proxy error pages.
- `cache_hit_dscp` (Number) DSCP value for packets served from the cache.
- `cache_on_disk` (Boolean) Keep the cache on disk instead of RAM.
- `cache_path` (String) Directory of the on-disk cache.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Enable the web proxy.
- `max_cache_object_size` (String) Largest object to cache, KiB (or `unlimited`).
- `max_cache_size` (String) Maximum cache size, KiB (`none`, `unlimited` or a number).
- `max_client_connections` (Number) Maximum number of client connections.
- `max_fresh_time` (String) Maximum time an object without an explicit expiry is considered fresh.
- `max_server_connections` (Number) Maximum number of connections to servers.
- `parent_proxy` (String) Address of the parent proxy (`::` or `0.0.0.0` - none).
- `parent_proxy_port` (Number) Port of the parent proxy (0 - none).
- `port` (Number) TCP port the proxy listens on.
- `serialize_connections` (Boolean) Do not open several connections to the server for several clients at once.
- `src_address` (String) Source address of connections to servers and the parent proxy (`::` - any).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import
Import is supported using the following syntax:
```shell
terraform import routeros_ip_proxy.this .
```
